title: steplock session state
description: Runtime state for one checklist scope (.steplock/sessions/<scope-key>/state.json).

checklist.description: Identifier of the checklist this scope is tracking (matches the directory name under .steplock/checklists/).

current_state.description: Name of the Mermaid state node currently being gated. Written by steplock on each block; advanced by `steplock step done` on each recorded step.

next_state.description: Auto-advance target for linear states (single outgoing transition). null for branching states — agent must pass the chosen state with `steplock step done --next`.

transitions.description: Valid next state names from current_state. `steplock step done` validates the outcome against this list.

flow_transitions.description: Outgoing transitions for every state in the flow. `steplock step done` reads it to set transitions and next_state for the state it advances to.

visited.description: State node names already recorded this scope. Written by `steplock step done`.
